g.text: Requirements: Node.js 18 or later, Rust with the x86_64-pc-windows-gnu host (no Visual Studio needed),
MinGW-w64 for windres, and Python 3 only if you regenerate the icons.

text.tspan: # Browser extension: copy pdf.js and mammoth into extension/lib
